name: סינמטק ירושלים
notes: Public, no login. Server-rendered day view: one day per page, items show title, DD.MM.YY date, HH:MM time and hall (סינמטק 1/2/3). Prices appear only on some items (e.g. 75 ₪ / 50 ₪ for subscribers); most screenings show no price, so leave price_text empty. Fetch today plus the next 6 days via ?date=. Hall names ('סינמטק 3') are the venue text and match the alias 'הסינמטק'/'סינמטק ירושלים'. Monthly program: https://jer-cin.org.il/he/node/4285

name: בית הנסן
notes: Public, HTTP 200 (also via WebFetch on https://www.hansen.co.il/). Lists events and exhibitions, each with a page at https://hansen.co.il/event/<slug>/. Single events have a date and time (e.g. a workshop Fri 20.11.2026 12:00). Many items are exhibitions with a date range and no time; per the extraction rules, skip ranges with no explicit start time. No per-event prices; the page says building entry is free, so only set is_free when the event text says so. Some dates contain typos (an end date before its start date); skip those.

name: עיריית ירושלים – אירועים בירושלים
notes: Public page (the old /he/events/ URL is a 404), but it blocks non-browser clients: WebFetch and Invoke-WebRequest both get HTTP 403. In a real browser the page loads, but the event cards are rendered by JavaScript behind filters (היום/מחר/שבוע הבא); only a featured banner showed in static text (חנוכה בירושלים 06.12-12.12.26). Not parseable by WebFetch, so it stays disabled. Enable it only if the collector uses a browser tool and reads the list after it renders.

name: הספרייה הלאומית
notes: Behind a Cloudflare browser challenge ('Checking your browser...', HTTP 403) for WebFetch, PowerShell and an automated browser. Do not try to bypass it. Disabled.
